title: Hilbert-Schmidt norm of the derivative of a map on R^1 equals the squared norm of the derivative along the coordinate line
statement: Let l be a natural number, w : R^1 -> R^l an arbitrary map (R^1 = EuclideanSpace R (Fin 1), R^l = EuclideanSpace R (Fin l)), and t a real number. Then hsNormSq(fderiv R w (EuclideanSpace.single 0 t)) = ||deriv (s |-> w(EuclideanSpace.single 0 s)) t||^2. Here fderiv and deriv are Mathlib's derivatives, both 0 at points of non-differentiability. hsNormSq B = sum over i : Fin 1 of ||B(EuclideanSpace.single i 1)||^2.
lean_statement: ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (w : Rn 1 → Rn ℓ) (t : ℝ), hsNormSq (fderiv ℝ w (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 1) t)) = ‖deriv (fun s : ℝ => w (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 1) s)) t‖ ^ 2
